card.name: Commas opening an added clause
card.fires_on: Commas after a noun phrase that introduce an aside, an appositive or a trailing clause, mostly in web text about search engines and science. Also the concessive word "Although" at the start of a sentence.

modes.label: Comma before aside
modes.description: A comma after a noun that leads into a non-essential clause such as "known as", "which are" or "notably".

modes.description: The word Although opening a sentence that sets up a contrast.

card.writes: It suppresses concession words such as "although" and "albeit" (including Chinese equivalents), so it seems to discourage a contrast clause from following.
card.plain: It fires on a comma that begins an extra descriptive phrase, or on the word Although, in ordinary web prose.
